sayWindow: 🪨 Carlos pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (3 stone now.)
🪵 Beatriz hauls back 4 wood. The pile grows. (27 logs now.)
🍂 Pavel gathers deadfall — 1 stick + 1 fiber. The pile grows. (3 sticks now.)
🍂 Dmitri gathers deadfall — 1 stick. The pile grows. (4 sticks now.)
Esmeralda doesn't bother arguing anymore. By dusk the Gather deadfall crews are taking orders from them, and nobody quite remembers when it changed.
You catch fragments by the fire — Beatriz telling A woman, maybe 50s about Aaliyah. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
Grayson showed Priya the Serviceberry — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
🪤 Grayson is back. "Snares were empty. They'll keep."
💧 Arman returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 50s returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 Carlos returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 Priya returns with water: +2 clean.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northwest called Emberhold. The region is bigger than your fire.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1111 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)

Esmeralda has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. A woman, maybe 50s is showing everyone a short viciously spiny palm with bunches of yellow-brown fruit like small coconuts by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The journal grows — the human way.
★ IDENTIFIED: Murumuru. Spiny palm, coconut-like fruit. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
You were listening. Now you know Murumuru too.

A woman, maybe 50s spends the afternoon with the tall serrated leaves on square stems that sting your hand when you grab them — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. Raw, it knots the stomach. Cooked... fine. The fire learns the rule before the name: cook it, or else.
From the lumped bag: Stinging Nettle — named, and out.
★ IDENTIFIED: Stinging Nettle. It stung you. Now you know. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
💡 Stinging Nettle. The tall serrated leaves on square stems that sting your hand when you grab them you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.
Aaliyah was watching. Now they know Stinging Nettle too.
The Journal notes it: Stinging Nettle — cook it, or else. (A woman, maybe 50s tested it.)
Dmitri is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 84/100)
Beatriz came back with 445 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 223 kcal in, 222 kcal eaten at the fire.
Arman and Esmeralda lingered over the fire together.
Priya and Carlos lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Dmitri sets the sharing basket down by the fire instead of the pantry. "Full shelves don't need my little more."
Priya spent the afternoon at the workbench, and the Arrow came apart in their hands. The materials are wasted.
— DAY 6 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, 3 Stinging Nettle; 2 unknown shoots went bad — beyond saving. You leave them for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: Murumuru — named and noted.
🔥 “I don’t say this lightly.” Fatima sets their bowl down. “Esmeralda, your past story isn’t true, is it? I’ve heard enough versions now.” Nobody looks at Esmeralda. Everybody does.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
MOLT: your skin splits. You step out new, whole — and naked. All equipped gear lost in the old skin. (Once per week.)
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND Molt. It resonates with: something unnamed.
(−100 kcal — food becomes molt.)
